vision.name: Goku Black's Zero Mortal Plan
vision.text:
(When this card is discarded or destroyed from your Life Deck, destroy a non-[Trait:God] Ally.)
POWER: Look at your opponent's hand and choose a card. Your opponent places that card on top of their Life Deck. If your opponent has no cards in their hand, raise or lower a player's anger 2.
vision.note: grey card; possessive title -> Named; inline icon zoomed: gold G badge (God); no Endurance badge
